confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026 peak season, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July demand swings prices widely. FX: the 0.6955 observation was taken from a search-result summary dated 15 October 2026 that attributed it to the RBA exchange-rates overview page. I did not open that page directly, so verify it against the RBA F11 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Western European capitals with high tourist demand and similar restaurant and hotel pricing, such as Brussels, Copenhagen and Paris, adjusted for Amsterdam's high summer hotel rates and its relatively expensive bars and cafes.
